text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The absence of fever, headache, neck stiffness, or neurological deficits like double vision or limb weakness, combined with the sudden onset of vertigo, points strongly to an inner ear crystal displacement rather than a central nervous system event like a stroke or infection. I recommend performing the Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm the diagnosis.
